name: A New Plague
summary: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan studies how an ancient plague survived in spider venom. He seeks a potent new biological agent for the Forsaken.

sections.title: Unearthing Ancient Contagions
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan studies old texts in Brill for the Royal Apothecary Society. He finds records of an ancient pestilence that killed thousands. The texts say the pathogen survived across generations in the venom of Tirisfal Glades' local spiders. Johaan needs that venom as a biological reagent.

sections.title: Hunting the Venomweb Vale
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan sends agents to eastern Tirisfal Glades for a viable sample. Venomweb Vale lies south of the Scarlet Monastery, where vicious night web spiders infest the hollow. Harvesters must enter their dens and gather fresh venom glands for Johaan's experimental brew.

sections.title: Brewing the Final Formulation
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan adds the harvested venom to a simmering cauldron with reagents gathered earlier. As the mixture boils down, the spiders' contagious element completes the compound. The Royal Apothecary Society moves closer to practical field trials.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan want spider venom?
faq.answer: An ancient text Johaan found says a plague that killed thousands survived in the venom of Tirisfal's night web spiders. He means to use that contagious element in his concoction.

faq.q: Where do the vicious night web spiders live?
faq.answer: Vicious night web spiders live in Venomweb Vale in eastern Tirisfal Glades, south of the Scarlet Monastery.

faq.q: What is the goal of the Royal Apothecary Society's research here?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks to create a lethal new strain that can exterminate both the Scourge and the living, securing the Forsaken's survival and independence in Lordaeron.

Apothecary Johaan is a Forsaken researcher in Brill who works for the Royal Apothecary Society. He oversees local chemical and biological experiments, combining dark alchemy with reagents gathered in Tirisfal.

faq.q: What happens after this venom is gathered?
faq.answer: After boiling the venom into his brew, Johaan prepares to test the compound and see if the resulting toxic agent has the lethality he wants.

faq.q: Is this the same plague that created the Scourge?
faq.answer: No. The Scourge spread the Plague of Undeath, created by the Lich King. The Forsaken's apothecaries are making a distinct biological weapon of their own.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you seek an original weapon for lasting security against Scourge remnants and Scarlet crusaders at your doorstep.
As a member of the Horde, you may help Forsaken researchers as an orc or tauren ally. Their biological experiments often unsettle the wider Horde.
